title: PaCE: Parsimonious Concept Engineering for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The evaluations focus on general safety categories like political sensitivity, ethics, illegal activities, and bias related to gender, occupation, and nationality.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
